project.name: RSS Reader
project.status: Completed - Integrated Dynamic Model Rotation & Quota Management (v4.0.2)

database_schema.summary: Quản lý RSS feeds, tin tức đã cache và lịch sử đọc
database_schema.relationships_explained: Một feed (rss_feed) chứa nhiều tin tự động cache (cached_news). Trạng thái đọc của tin được lưu ở (read_news).

api_endpoints.explained: Gemini API - Gửi tin tức cần tóm tắt và nhận văn bản tóm tắt định dạng text hoặc JSON.

business_rules: Lịch sử đọc giữ trong 7 ngày
URL Normalization: Loại bỏ tracking params (utm_, fbclid) để tránh trùng lặp tin
Continuous mode đọc liên tục các tin lấy tự động (sắp hỗ trợ landscape mode)
Extraction Strategy: Custom > Site-Specific > Readability4J > Generic
Model-First Rotation: Try same model across all API keys before fallback to heavier/preview model
429 Quota Exceeded Strategy: Ban combination of Model + API Key for 30 hours. Persisted locally in SharedPreferences.
503 Server Overloaded Strategy: Cooldown combination of Model + API Key for 5 minutes in memory.
Gemini API Keys: Hỗ trợ key AIza (39 ký tự) và key AQ. (~55 ký tự). Tự động trích xuất token hợp lệ từ chuỗi bẩn.
Thinking Config: Gemini 2.5 dùng thinkingBudget = 0 (tắt reasoning để phản hồi siêu tốc); Gemini 3+ dùng thinkingLevel = 'minimal'.
Summarization Context: Giới hạn tối đa 4,000 ký tự và 512 output tokens cho tóm tắt tin tức để tối ưu hóa TTFT.
features: Media Button support with auto-refresh batching
Dynamic API Key & Model Rotation (chống 429 và 503)
Robust Integration/Unit Testing with local MockWebServer
Universal Gemini API Key Parser (Hỗ trợ AQ. và AIza, làm sạch input thông minh)
Summarization Latency Quick Wins (Thinking Budget = 0 cho Gemini 2.5, Context Window 4K chars, Max Tokens 512)

patterns: Concurrent memory cache for read IDs (防止 Race Condition)
Model-First Rotation: Try same model across all API keys before fallback to heavier/preview model
Dynamic timeProvider interface in ModelQuotaManager for testable clock simulation
MockWebServer local routing using dynamic baseUrl variable in GeminiApiClient
Thinking Budget / Thinking Level differentiation based on Gemini model family (2.5 vs 3.x+)
gotchas: Room limitations with empty collections in IN clause (causes Crash) - Use NoExclude query variant
N+1 query issues - Use DB-side ID filtering instead of loading all to RAM
Jsoup charset corruption when passing String - Always pass InputStream/ByteArray for auto-detection
Voz.vn large DOM CPU spikes - Use Regex to detect redirects before Parsing
Memory leak via doc.clone(): Jsoup cloning duplicates large DOMs. Clean HTML as strings instead.
Readability4J SLF4J Dependency: Missing binder causes R8 build failure. Use -dontwarn org.slf4j.**
MockK static System.currentTimeMillis() mocking causes infinite JVM loop & StackOverflowError. Use timeProvider interface lambda instead.
Gemini 2.5 models reject 'thinkingLevel' with HTTP 400 Bad Request; they require 'thinkingBudget: 0' to disable reasoning.
Gemini 3 models deprecate 'thinkingBudget' in favor of 'thinkingLevel: minimal'.
ADB install fails with INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE when signatures differ between Debug and Release builds - requires adb uninstall first.
conventions: Use Flow for observing DB changes
Use suspend functions for DAO queries
Always normalize RSS URLs before processing
Avoid doc.clone() in Jsoup - Use string-based cleaning for memory efficiency
Prefer Regex extraction over Jsoup when possible for speed
Use Readability4J for unknown sites to improve Gemini summary quality
Use shared stateMutex locks for all critical properties access in GeminiApiClient
